d967ba7741f46dd2644b7dde576d2fa4.speaker: Narration
d967ba7741f46dd2644b7dde576d2fa4.text: They walked into lands where no bird sang: the lands of Malada and Karusha.

f5433bdd0b4e62ed538275a1cd33346c.speaker: Vishvamitra
f5433bdd0b4e62ed538275a1cd33346c.text: No bird sings here. Listen to what silence costs a land.

510165d94e7b857d0e01fece449c2c1a.speaker: Vishvamitra
510165d94e7b857d0e01fece449c2c1a.text: Tataka rules this forest. Once a yakshini of great strength, she became a terror after a sage's curse. Her son Maricha follows her.

07f44fcf5971e5d66321a1fbbccd3e3c.speaker: Lakshmana
07f44fcf5971e5d66321a1fbbccd3e3c.text: Stay close, brother. The trees themselves are watching.

dadb93a8a103977943ad42470cbbe570.speaker: Narration
dadb93a8a103977943ad42470cbbe570.text: Golden Ayodhya, on the banks of the Sarayu. The princes trained beneath their guru's eye...

33ceb37b4abb6ffd2221a0a1b6af8c96.speaker: Vasishtha
33ceb37b4abb6ffd2221a0a1b6af8c96.text: An arrow obeys the hand. The hand must obey something higher.

ab014a2842264d319b522351da5a46eb.speaker: Lakshmana
ab014a2842264d319b522351da5a46eb.text: Brother, leave one for me. Just one.

e217177bafa233251f0f9fb1417de09e.speaker: Vasishtha
e217177bafa233251f0f9fb1417de09e.text: Then let us see what you have learned. These are only shadows of my making. Face them as if they were not.

d728966b1fc98f810076ba29fc9396f0.speaker: Narration
d728966b1fc98f810076ba29fc9396f0.text: Then came a sage to the palace gate, and with him the first step of a long road.

d905ab50e7f9e0bc7ad5ae835d90e93c.speaker: Vishvamitra
d905ab50e7f9e0bc7ad5ae835d90e93c.text: King of Ayodhya. Rakshasas defile my sacrifice in the forest. I ask for Rama.

54bcf3df07d5c4d699fad729452392e0.speaker: Dasharatha
54bcf3df07d5c4d699fad729452392e0.text: He is not yet sixteen. Take my army, take me. Not my son.

036addc5b8c67cd596022e442cd20751.speaker: Vishvamitra
036addc5b8c67cd596022e442cd20751.text: A king who promises and then bargains has forgotten whose son he is.

d95180820e4d04d863ca2b688b44be0d.speaker: Vasishtha
d95180820e4d04d863ca2b688b44be0d.text: Let him go, my king. With this sage, no harm can reach him.

1d06dc37c37913085e1d1994da65eb9f.speaker: Rama
1d06dc37c37913085e1d1994da65eb9f.text: Father, I will return. Bless the bow, not only the boy.

5a702c5ef1aa0fb27b1df8e0e4ea0570.speaker: Lakshmana
5a702c5ef1aa0fb27b1df8e0e4ea0570.text: Where my brother walks, I walk.

d7ca2b1256aa5ceb3f1d2cbfe8a3c687.speaker: Dasharatha
d7ca2b1256aa5ceb3f1d2cbfe8a3c687.text: Go then, both of you. And come back to me.

c7475caa263c4fb930f7b001e5274e79.speaker: Lakshmana
c7475caa263c4fb930f7b001e5274e79.text: Brother... look. The forest is breathing again.

abc00805449c6cb4811171b8ca98fade.speaker: Vishvamitra
abc00805449c6cb4811171b8ca98fade.text: The curse is lifted from this land. You did not strike in anger, Rama. That is why you may now receive what I carry.

ae28355b138a837c021194caf16a869b.speaker: The Astras
ae28355b138a837c021194caf16a869b.text: Command us, and we will come.

9446a678af0438d9014f8570e14ce3bf.speaker: Vishvamitra
9446a678af0438d9014f8570e14ce3bf.text: Agneyastra, the fire that burns only what must burn. Varunastra, the water that cleanses. Vayavyastra, the wind that clears the field.

b81b93f0e7cf3d5f5b3f94ed9cdbd4ee.speaker: Rama
b81b93f0e7cf3d5f5b3f94ed9cdbd4ee.text: I will call on them only for dharma, Guru-dev.

96f2bed07a1120da3d59b1e0bf9c5b76.speaker: Narration
96f2bed07a1120da3d59b1e0bf9c5b76.text: And so the princes walked on toward Siddhashrama, where six nights of fire awaited them...

cb163cf284997ff035a3f840313996a0.speaker: Tataka
cb163cf284997ff035a3f840313996a0.text: Princes of men, in my forest? I will grind your bones to dust as I did the others.

fb0d0b2ca9de0607387c64c135993d22.speaker: Rama
fb0d0b2ca9de0607387c64c135993d22.text: Guru-dev, she is a woman. Is there no other way?

674a0cb46a1912d0f09a625cdc40056a.speaker: Vishvamitra
674a0cb46a1912d0f09a625cdc40056a.text: Ask instead: how many have no other way while she lives? A protector's duty does not look away.

364c4d3de314570121cee028d708169a.speaker: Rama
364c4d3de314570121cee028d708169a.text: Then I will try to turn her back first. If she will not turn, I will not look away.

c4af81c55fd5dc513e8d179f89d455e1.speaker: Rama
c4af81c55fd5dc513e8d179f89d455e1.text: It burned without touching me, Guru-ji. Is that what power is?

62edc5d65d9db342d806d903264bbf55.speaker: Vasishtha
62edc5d65d9db342d806d903264bbf55.text: That is what restraint is. Remember the feeling.

5e5fe17d54c19dd7b48621e7f47dcffd.speaker: Herald
5e5fe17d54c19dd7b48621e7f47dcffd.text: My princes! A sage stands at the palace gate: Vishvamitra of Kaushika's line.

520967ff6f93f2a97b50e4424f5e8ac8.speaker: Lakshmana
520967ff6f93f2a97b50e4424f5e8ac8.text: The forest grows quiet again. Too quiet.

a09bc6d221e2ea9736bb30fd9e042bd9.speaker: Lakshmana
a09bc6d221e2ea9736bb30fd9e042bd9.text: Rakshasas, brother! Real ones, this time.

93b3af9b48ebb5c24870cb9d65f84085.speaker: Lakshmana
93b3af9b48ebb5c24870cb9d65f84085.text: He had already turned to flee...
